_note: The towns each shipped gust correction covers (PLAN §4, §8.6): within 12 km of the station, ground within 150 m of it, same side of the mountains and of the coast; each town a point with its own radius (km, default 5) from GeoNames (towns-near.mjs). Written by hand, 28 Sept 2026.

68817.why: Cape Town harbour (Portnet, 2 m): the low-lying city side of Table Mountain and Signal Hill, facing Table Bay. Not the mountain slopes (Tamboerskloof, Oranjezicht, Higgovale: 90-165 m, where the south-easter comes down harder), not the Atlantic seaboard behind Signal Hill (Sea Point, Clifton, Camps Bay), not the southern suburbs in the mountain's lee, not the open coast north (Milnerton, Table View).

68176.why: Mara (Limpopo, 897 m): Mara village on the same plain, 7.7 km, 6 m lower. The other villages within 12 km are left out: they lie towards the Soutpansberg and their exposure was not checked.
